title: A global direct-detection combination for inelastic dark matter after the LZ event: the surviving (m_chi, delta, sigma_n) region
question: Which (m_chi, delta, sigma_n) survives LZ's event plus all zero-event archival xenon exposures and non-xenon limits; joint best fit and its shift; Higgsino window; exclusion-mode limits; which future exposure shrinks the region most?
headline_result: Joint region (isoscalar O1, 90%, 2 dof): m_chi >= 400 GeV, delta = 335-390 keV and sigma_n = 8e-42 - 3e-36 cm^2 at 1 TeV; archival zeros (0.31-0.33 events, 99.6% SR1) cut kappa_hat by 24% and Z by 0.06-0.11 sigma but only 2-3% of the region; Higgsino allowed at delta = 365-380 keV; only data beyond 270 keV (LZ 1000 phd edge or CaWO4) shrink the region substantially
key_numbers: 1 TeV joint best delta=380 keV, sigma_n=4.9e-38; 68% 360-385 keV, 2.8e-40-7.4e-37; 90% 330-390, 8.2e-42-2.8e-36; m<=300 GeV excluded (Delta>=5.3), flat above 1 TeV; kappa ratio 0.76 (delta<=370) -> 0.91 (390), dZ -0.11 -> -0.03; Higgsino delta=370 (68% 365-375, 90% 365-380); exclusion-mode sigma_n < 3.9e-42/2.0e-40/1.1e-37 at 300/350/380 keV (x0.75-0.81 of LZ-only); future area fractions LZ+6.76 t yr 0.55, XENONnT 3.1 0.70, LZ 1000 phd 0.04, CaWO4 100 kg yr 0.006; CRESST/PICO 3800x/1440x above region at 350 keV
model_or_mechanism: Isoscalar O1 inelastic DM; joint extended likelihood = P021 LZ model (P038 MC edge) x Poisson zeros of archival xenon exposures above 100 keV; Fig. S7 non-xenon limits; Asimov projections
result_type: computed (regions, shifts, limits) / estimated (projections, non-xenon extrapolation)
confidence: medium - LZ-only pieces reproduce P021/P038 to 0.02 sigma and archival counts reproduce P059, but archival ROIs/edges are recalled
agent_tools: Read x20, Bash x16, Write x4, Edit x16, Skill x1 (dataviz)
software_and_packages: python 3.12.13; WimPyDD 2.0.4 (per-stream diff_rate, eft_hamiltonian, streamed_halo_function); numpy 2.5.3; scipy 1.18.1; pandas 3.0.5; matplotlib 3.11.2; common/lzcommon.py
local_inputs: fulltext.tex (l.116-117, 455-457, 798-818, bib); P021 spectra/details/script; P059 details/script; P038 MC efficiency + 1000 GeV spectra; P016 Fig.5 bins; P007 Higgsino couplings; P015 figS7_curves.json; P046 rates_vs_delta.csv; P069 ledger; ledger; lzcommon
recalled_knowledge: 14 items: (hbar c)^2, chi2 quantiles/Wilks, Poisson ULs (certain); SR1 exposure/g1 (likely), SR1 zero high-S1c events (uncertain); XENON1T/LUX/PandaX-II/XENONnT/PandaX-4T exposures and ROI edges (certain-uncertain); PICO-60 CF3I exposure (likely), PICO 2023 inelastic paper (certain); CDMS-II inelastic 2011 (likely); no Ge/NaI high-energy analysis known (uncertain); CaWO4 W fraction, Okabe-Ito (certain)
